in_sanskrit.name: जगन्नाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jagan comes from the Sanskrit word 'jagat' meaning 'the world' and 'nath' meaning 'lord'. Jagan is a name given to various Hindu deities representing the supreme power of the universe.

in_hindi.name: जगन
in_hindi.long_meaning: Jagan in Hindi translates to 'one who protects the universe'. It is also a common name for boys in India.

in_tamil.name: ஜகன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Jagan in Tamil means 'protector of the world'. It is a name given to various Hindu deities and also used as a personal name for boys in Tamil Nadu.

in_telugu.name: జగన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Jagan in Telugu translates to 'Lord of the Universe'. It is also a common name for boys in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

in_marathi.name: Jagan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ jagat ’, which means ‘the world’. The name Jagan is a revered name for God or a powerful deity. It is a popular name for boys in Hindu culture.

in_bengali.name: Jagan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord, God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jagan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jagan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ jagat ’, which means ‘the world’. The name Jagan is a revered name for God or a powerful deity. It is a popular name for boys in Hindu culture.
